recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓切片可見大量核卵圓、染色質淡的組織球樣大細胞，部分細胞質內可見聚集的紅血球（疑似噬血現象），並夾雜嗜酸性球與出血；H&E 下無法確認巨大顆粒。
features: Many large cells with oval, vesicular nuclei and abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm (histiocyte-like)
Some cells contain clustered red cells, suggestive of hemophagocytosis
Admixed eosinophils, lymphocytes and erythroid precursors
Interstitial hemorrhage and loosely cohesive architecture
Occasional mitotic figure; giant granules not resolvable on H&E
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at high power shows a hypercellular, hemorrhagic marrow with a prominent population of large histiocyte-like cells with oval vesicular nuclei and abundant pale cytoplasm, several of which appear to contain clustered erythrocytes. Eosinophils, lymphocytes and erythroid precursors are admixed. Giant cytoplasmic granules cannot be assessed on this section. In the setting of Chediak-Higashi syndrome, findings are suggestive of the accelerated phase with hemophagocytic histiocytic infiltration; CD163 immunostain and aspirate correlation are recommended.

ddx.vs: Histology overlaps; LYST genotype and giant granules on aspirate favor CHS.
LCH cells have grooved nuclei and are CD1a/langerin positive, without prominent hemophagocytosis.
Mast cells are spindled or oval with clear cytoplasm, form paratrabecular/perivascular aggregates and express tryptase/CD117.
